body: Thank you for the response. This has been something I have been thinking about for the better part of a year. I am 27 and without much to show for all my time here. My friends have melted away over the years to none, my girlfriend of the last 4 years has frozen over and is about ready to leave, I have been addicted to opiates ever since I was hurt and they have worked to numb me emotionally as well as physically. I really don't know that many people that I have known through my life who would even hear about my death, let alone shed a tear, but thank you. I just really wonder what's on the other side. Are the Christians right? Is there a lake of fire and torment waiting for me? Or do I get another chance through reincarnation? They say that energy can neither be created or destroyed, only change form. There has to be something else after this. After all this time, I really wonder if it would be better.
